review.boundary_review: The gutter lies at about x 3210. The arrows at about [3085,3355] and [4190] are on the target side. The arrow near y~880, the ticks, 'Yājuṣa', 'Yājuṣahautra', 'See Pariśiṣṭa' and the circled 'Yativīdhi' are on fol. 207 and are correctly excluded. Mark heights on the target page match the arrows on fol. 207 for the Yajurmañjarī (d.355), c.461 and Yatīnāṃ smṛti lines. These attachments remain probable, not secure.
